digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration schema and resolver
propositions: Rebar needs a schema to express which model to use for each capability tier (frontier/standard/trivial) instead of a single scalar cfg.model
Each class slot must accept model, provider, endpoint, and an optional non-recursive fallback array; fallback entries must not contain api_key or nested fallbacks
Environment variables REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_<FIELD> must address structured slots by field name while preserving existing precedence (CLI > env > config file > default)
A resolver function must convert class name to provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted and preserving bare-id behavior
When no class configuration is present, frontier/standard/trivial must resolve to claude-opus-4-8/claude-sonnet-4-6/claude-haiku-4-5 respectively to preserve current behavior
The parser and resolver must be exposed via load_class_slots() entry point in a new model_classes.py module that reads the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config, keeping config.py under its 800-LOC hard cap
